phase_name: Add pid liveness to holder.json and make reaping fail safe

objectives.description: Extend write_holder() to persist pid and pid_source, reusing resolve_session_pid
Update every write_holder call site to thread pid/pid_source (preserve on heartbeat, fresh-resolve on acquire)
cmd_reap refuses to reap a lock whose recorded pid is alive
cmd_acquire's stale-override refuses to override a lock whose recorded pid is alive
Update holder.json schema comment in task-lock.sh and task-lock.md

manual_smoke_evidence: Fixture acquire writes pid+pid_source (fresh-resolved) into holder.json.
Fixture heartbeat preserves the pid already on record (424242) rather than re-resolving to the calling process's own pid.
reap --dry-run SKIPs a stale-by-timestamp lock whose pid is confirmably alive (this process's own pid); reaps a stale lock whose pid is confirmably dead (bogus pid 9999999).

acquire's stale-override ABORTs (exit 1) against a stale lock with a live pid, naming the pid; succeeds with override-and-warn against a stale lock with a dead pid or no pid field at all (legacy behavior unchanged).
regression_evidence: bash agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/run-all.sh in source-store mode: 56 passed, 0 failed -- includes test-task-lock-reap.sh, test-four-tier-conflict.sh, test-session-registry.sh, test-conflict-predicate.sh.
